status: post-hoc paired-support mechanism attribution frozen after the phase3 panel-level result and before paired phase-vs-collapsed output
role: post-freeze exploratory localization; cannot alter v0.3.8 or serve as independent confirmation

hypothesis_origin.rationale: Determine whether the 2023 loss of identity after phase conditioning reflects phase information itself rather than reduced support/sparsity.

paired_estimand.target_support: For each target session under each observed/permuted label assignment, define scored target endpoints exclusively by support of the full cell × speed×turn × phase predictor in both self and other profiles.
paired_estimand.collapsed_model: P(z_residual | 5-km cell, speed×turn state), trained from the same phase-valid endpoint pool but with phase labels collapsed
paired_estimand.target_matching: Score both models on exactly the same phase-model-supported target endpoints.
paired_estimand.session_statistic: mean target [log P_self_phase - log P_other_phase] minus mean target [log P_self_collapsed - log P_other_collapsed]
paired_estimand.panel_statistic: equal target session within individual, then equal individual
paired_estimand.interpretation_of_negative: Conditioning on phase removes part of the same-individual predictive advantage on an identical target-support set.

calibration.permutation_unit: whole session label within frozen cohort
calibration.preserve: session x-y-time-state-phase-z block and exact per-cohort session-count multiset per label
calibration.primary_test: observed paired phase increment < permutation null mean and one-sided p(null <= observed) <= 0.05

claim_boundary: This test was generated after observing the 2023 phase-conditioned failure; it is mechanistic localization, not confirmatory discovery.
Relative tracked-session phase is not solar/circadian phase.
A negative paired increment supports phase-linked organization relative to this proxy; it does not establish wet-season causation or a specific resource mechanism.
The test cannot distinguish resource timing, learned schedules, social timing or unmeasured time-varying environment.
This extension remains outside frozen v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change target support, phase definition, collapsed model, aggregation, exact n, B, seed or one-sided direction after any paired output.
Do not switch to phase2 or select individual phases if the primary paired attribution fails.
